word: Title: Afternoon At The Market
answer: Tarde En El Mercado

word: I give the vendor exact change.
answer: Doy el cambio exacto al vendedor.

word: You are going to let the kids choose a snack. [pl]
answer: Van a dejar que los niños elijan una botana.

word: We drink a cold agua fresca.
answer: Bebemos una agua fresca fría.

word: They finish choosing their vegetables.
answer: Acaban de escoger sus verduras.

word: You pay for the fruit at the counter. [sing, inf]
answer: Pagas la fruta en la caja.

word: I spend a little more on fresh tortillas.
answer: Gasto un poco más en tortillas frescas.

word: We take out the bags from the cart.
answer: Sacamos las bolsas del carrito.

word: They remove the stems from the strawberries.
answer: Quitan los tallos de las fresas.

word: You drive slowly through the busy street. [sing, formal]
answer: Maneja despacio por la calle llena.

word: I am going to open the bag to check it.
answer: Voy a abrir la bolsa para revisarla.

word: We love the smell of warm bread.
answer: Amamos el olor del pan calientito.

word: They wash the fruit at the sink.
answer: Lavan la fruta en el fregadero.

word: You cook a quick meal with fresh ingredients. [pl]
answer: Cocinan una comida rápida con ingredientes frescos.

word: We clean the table before eating.
answer: Limpiamos la mesa antes de comer.

word: They dry the lettuce with a towel.
answer: Secan la lechuga con una toalla.

word: You are going to bathe the baby after lunch. [sing, inf]
answer: Vas a bañar al bebé después de comer.

word: I matter to the vendor because I come often.
answer: Importo al vendedor porque vengo seguido.

word: We interest the kids with colorful fruit.
answer: Interesamos a los niños con fruta colorida.

word: They bother no one; they’re calm today.
answer: No molestan a nadie; están tranquilos hoy.

word: You win a small discount. [sing, formal]
answer: Gana un pequeño descuento.

word: We go up the ramp with the cart.
answer: Subimos la rampa con el carrito.

word: They come down the stairs carefully.
answer: Bajan las escaleras con cuidado.

word: You dance a little to the music outside. [pl]
answer: Bailan un poco con la música de afuera.

word: I am going to tie the bags tightly.
answer: Voy a atar bien las bolsas.

word: We tell the vendor we’ll return soon.
answer: Contamos al vendedor que volveremos pronto.
